name: card-review
description: Review structured item lists in a local browser with persistent A/B decisions, notes, and JSONL results.

interface.shortDescription: Review item lists in a persistent local card UI
interface.longDescription: Card Review turns structured tasks, proposals, documents, diffs, or other item lists into a dependency-free local browser workflow with A/B classification, skip, memo, navigation, undo/redo, resume, partial completion, and stable JSONL results.
defaultPrompt: Use Card Review to review these items
